remarks: Soft shades of cream and white, generous windows, and beautifully remodeled living spaces bring a fresh, inviting feel to this two-bedroom, two-bath manufactured home in Cypress. Bathed in natural light, the living and dining areas unfold beneath a 9' vaulted ceiling, while gray-toned laminate flooring provides an elegant foundation for your own furnishings and personal style. Dual-pane windows welcome abundant daylight and open to encourage cross ventilation, inviting fresh air and gentle breezes throughout the home.
